# Task 53 CLI catalog fixture

Repository-authored temporary local catalogs (repository license), generated by t53_tests.rs. Each has `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`, a local `./pkg` entry named `fixture`, and an unchanged original manifest. Versions `1`/`2` exercise explicit update; alpha/beta catalogs exercise identity isolation. No credentials or external package.

Reference: frozen Codex cli/plugin_cmd.rs and cli/marketplace_cmd.rs; the existing host PluginCommands spelling is retained. Commands: marketplace add/list, read, list, install, update, enable, disable, remove. Catalog registration is local-only; it does not pretend to fetch Git catalog snapshots. Git/npm entries inside registered catalogs use existing audited install factories, including Git subdirectories on upgrade. Explicit `update --source` also supports installed local packages.

Tests parse clap arguments and call the actual CLI handler against real filesystem catalogs. Assertions cover installed/upgraded versions, original manifest bytes, rejected unknown/invalid sources, and exact-market removal. Registry persistence uses a bounded schema, exclusive lock and atomic replacement outside packages.
